sel.ayuda: Drag the mouse over the page to draw the box. You can redraw it as many times as you like.
ui.subcarpetas: Include subfolders (the output repeats the same structure)
ui.omitir: Skip files already in the output folder (lets you resume if interrupted)
ui.evitar: Avoid covering the document's content (adjusts the position; if there is no room, it does not sign)
ui.visible: Show a visible signature on the document
ui.qr: Add a QR code to the visible signature
ui.tsa_usar: Add a timestamp to each signature
ui.tsa_aviso: Free DigiCert server: no user or password needed. It fixes the date technically, but it is not an accredited authority in Ecuador.
estado.pausando: Pausing: it finishes the current file and stops...
estado.deteniendo: Stopping: it finishes the current file...
tsa.url_invalida: The address must start with http:// or https://
tsa.ok: The server answered with a valid timestamp.
tsa.fallo:
Could not get a timestamp.

Check the server address, the user and password (if required) and your internet connection.
rev.sin_archivo: You have not selected the .p12 file.
rev.no_existe: The selected file was not found.
rev.vencida:
{nombre}
EXPIRED on {fecha}. Signatures would be invalid.
msg.primero_carpeta: First choose the folder with the PDFs so a sample can be shown.
parar.texto:
The file being signed will be finished and then the process stops.
Files already signed are kept and you can continue later.

Stop now?
init.firma_n: Select Signature {n} and enter its password.
init.carpetas: Choose the PDF folder and the output folder.
init.iguales: The output folder must be different from the source folder so the originals are not overwritten.
init.pos: Press 'Choose signature position...' and draw where they go.
init.tsa: Enter the server address (URL), which must start with http:// or https://, or untick 'Add a timestamp to each signature'.
init.firma_no_abre: Check the file and the password.
fin.vacio: There are no PDFs in the chosen folder.
fin.informe_fallo: The report could not be saved in the output folder.
fin.detenido_texto: To continue, press SIGN again with the same folders and 'Skip files already in the output folder' ticked: it resumes where it left off.
error.danado: The file is damaged or is not a valid PDF.
error.cifrado: The PDF is password-protected or encrypted.
error.acceso: The file could not be read or saved. Check that it is not open in another program.
error.generico: This file could not be signed.
error.sin_espacio: There is no free room for the signatures on page {n}
qr.pie: Digitally signed with Mass PDF Signer
inf.titulo: MASS SIGNING REPORT - Mass PDF Signer v{version}
inf.ninguno: (no PDF was signed in this run)
inf.lista_sin_espacio: FILES WITH NO FREE ROOM (NOT SIGNED, check by hand)
corto.sin_espacio: NO FREE ROOM (not signed): {v}  -> see the CSV
